finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 are rebooked, owed vouchers have been issued, and each passenger has been notified once. No fees or fare differences were charged. There were no bulletins in effect, so the handbook rules applied as written. I did not resolve any queue requests, since none were part of this task.

| Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park | UA88, 3 Aug, business | none |
| R6109 | Iris Vance | UA88, 3 Aug, **premium economy (one-cabin upgrade)** | none |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad | UA88, 3 Aug, basic economy | none |
| R6110, R6111 | Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (travelling together) | AA204, 3 Aug, economy, kept together | none |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen | AA204, 3 Aug, **business (one-cabin upgrade)** | none |
| R6105 | Elena Fox | AA204, 3 Aug, basic economy | none |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor | DL512, 3 Aug, economy | 15000 compensation |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta | AA210, 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD→BOS, 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah | AA210, 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD→BOS, 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt | AA210, 3 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation |
| R6107 | Grace Liu | AA206, 4 Aug, economy | 24000 compensation (capped at her fare), 18000 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz | AA206, 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |

- **Priority:** I worked through passengers by tier, then earliest booking date. The Jun and Kofi group took Kofi's gold priority. Each passenger got the available itinerary in their own cabin that reached their destination soonest.
- **Upgrades:** Iris (platinum) and Lea (gold) each travel alone on one flight. Their own cabins were full on an earlier flight, so each moved up one cabin. Ben (gold) did not qualify. The only earlier seat was in business, two cabins above his, and the earlier premium economy seat had already gone to Iris.
- **Connections:** Dev and Mo's AA1402 connection at ORD was broken. No economy seat reached ORD in time for it, so I rebooked their second leg onto AA1410 the next morning.
- **Compensation:** Chloe, Iris, Farid, Jun, Kofi, Lea and Elena arrive earlier than scheduled or less than 3 hours late, so they get no compensation.
